verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants act directly on a Brex account through natural language: managing expenses, looking up users, checking cards, reviewing banking transactions and tracking bills. The docs include a concrete install command, and Brex AI assistants handle employee expense tasks such as writing memos and filing reimbursements. Community 'gimmickry' remarks are general skepticism, not a concrete failure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works, and detailed docs on which write actions and tools the MCP server exposes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions, track bills, and more through natural language.
claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp
AI assistants do employees' expenses for them, writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help, even filing reimbursements automatically.
